system.description:
Street swashbuckling: broken bottles, stolen coins, fighting dirty with style. It comes from the Mournas underground and Lankhmar's Cheap Street.

  • Anything Goes: you gain Disarming Strike at 1st level, for held items other than weapons (flask, key, document, pouch); from 7th level it works on any held item. It needs no save if your attack roll beats the target's AC by 5 or more and the target is no more than one size larger than you.
    • 9th level: with a free hand, you may catch an item you could hold in one hand.
  • Underclass Instinct: Advantage on checks to blend into the underclass, sell stolen goods, and deceive guards.
